text:
Maria Chen: quick update — rolled out the sparsity-aware allocator + fused-gemm path to canary (5%) for the helix model family. initial numbers look promising :eyes:
Devon: nice — what metrics are we seeing?
Maria Chen: p50 down ~12%, p95 down ~9%, p99 down ~7% on canary traffic. token cost per request dropped ~11% for the traced workload.
Samir: where are those measured? bench or production traces?
Maria Chen: production canary traces + internal bench. here's the canary summary we posted to monitoring: 
```
canary: 5% traffic
model: helix-3b-v2
p50(before): 42ms -> (after): 37ms  (-11.9%)
p95(before): 112ms -> (after): 102ms (-8.9%)
p99(before): 310ms -> (after): 288ms (-7.1%)
per-token-cost(before): $0.00072 -> (after): $0.00064 (-11.1%)
errors: no spike, 5xx stable
```
Olga: amazing numbers. any change in output quality / token distribution?
Maria Chen: ran eval set (regression prompts) — negligible delta in logprobs and top-1 token agreement ~99.6%. still doing extended evals but so far ok.
Priya: SLO-wise, do we need new alerts? p99 moved a bit but improved. should be fine.
Samir: what's the rollout plan?
Maria Chen: staged: 5% -> 20% in 2h -> 50% in 6h -> 100% in 24h, auto-rollback on cost/regression trigger. feature-flag name: alloc.sparsity.fused_gemm
Product-Luke: awesome — can we call this out in the weekly product update as a cost win? ops loves this. :tada:
Devon: any changes needed on Dedicated customers?
Maria Chen: nothing customer-facing. it's purely runtime kernel/allocator change. Dedicated still needs optional scheduler knob but default stays safe.
deploy-bot: canary deploy started by maria@infra at 2025-02-14T17:02:10Z — job id: deploy-helix-4271.
Samir: one more ask — add a short dashboard card for this feature so people can see p50/p95/p99 + cost delta per model.
Maria Chen: will do, adding dashboard + alert rule for regressions.
Priya: tagged eng-oncall so they see the rollout if anything odd pops up.
Olga: excellent work team — congrats :party_parrot: 
Maria Chen: thanks y'all — will post final 24h summary here once rollout completes.
Devon: if anyone sees weird tokenization or off-by-one hallucinations, ping me and samir immediately.
Maria Chen: noted. rolling to 20% now.
